title: A Promise for the Garden Revisited
author: Dominic Reyes
blurb: Lena Vane, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
